statement: For every integer n>=3 and every unordered pair B of black squares in an n by n grid, |RP(G_B)| is given by the exhaustive coordinate-dependent factorial formulas (C), (E), (S), and (I) in evidence/factorial_formulas.md, together with the opposite-corner and exceptional common-boundary-row/column formulas proved in evidence/finite_census.md; every remaining relative-position class has value zero because its across- and down-word counts differ. Formula (I) distinguishes the parallel and crossed orders of two nonattacking interior squares. This claim is a complete exact counting formula for every two-black-square configuration, but it does not assert or prove the all-n discrete maximum M_2(n) or its equality classification.
contribution: This subsidiary classification reduces the source's first untreated fixed-black-square extremal layer to an explicit finite-dimensional integer optimization, supplies exact formulas for all three classes left unresolved after the word-count reduction, and gives the exact n=15 edge-cross counterexample {(1,7),(7,1)} to the provisional opposite-corner extrapolation. The formulas are checked against all 620 D4 orbit records representing all 4,278 configurations for 3<=n<=8. A targeted same-date primary-literature search recorded in problem.md found the source paper but no separate resolution; this is bounded negative evidence, not a claim of priority.
